newsitem.title: USA: Beatles top U.S. charts with third anthology.
newsitem.headline: Beatles top U.S. charts with third anthology.

text.p: The third and final anthology of rare Beatles songs continued the tradition of the first two collections by debuting at the top of the U.S. album charts, the band's label said Wednesday.

However, first week sales also continued their downward spiral: "The Beatles Anthology 3" sold about 237,000 copies in the week ended November 3, whereas the second instalment entered the charts with 442,000 copies in March and the first one opened with a staggering 855,500 last November.
The latest album consists of 50 first takes and out-takes and unreleased songs from the so-called "White Album", "Let It Be" and "Abbey Road" years of 1968-1970.

Capitol Records said "Anthology 3" becomes the group's 18th number one, breaking its own record. Capitol, a unit of Britain's EMI Group Plc, handles the Beatles in the U.S. under a licensing deal with the group's Apple Corp.
